acc.summary: What the listing says about taking it
body: For the box, nothing. There is no schedule, no daily count and no order of items printed on this listing. It says the book carries the step by step instructions.
For the two jars separately: the gel's page prints one tablespoon each morning. Detox Redox prints no serving at all, which is on its sheet and on this one.

The gel goes in the fridge, used within 28 days of opening or frozen, with a clean dry spoon. The capsules do not want the fridge. Detox Redox prints no storage instruction of its own, so keep the lid on somewhere cool and dry, out of the sun.
Anyone with an overactive thyroid should leave the gel alone, and if you take thyroid medication ask your GP or pharmacist before you start. Seaweed carries iodine.

Not in pregnancy or while breastfeeding. Not for children. If you take prescribed medicine of any kind, including a blood thinner or anything for diabetes, speak to your GP or pharmacist first. Detox Redox does not print a full ingredient list, and nobody can give you a caution for an ingredient nobody has printed.

Sent out from 599 Smithdown Road, Liverpool, Tuesday to Sunday. A box with a gel in it goes out chilled. UK delivery is free over £50, or you can collect from the shop between 10 and 6, any day except Monday.

spec.intro: What the box holds, what it costs, and the three figures this listing does not print.
spec.caption: 28 Day Kit
rows: Three jars of Detox Redox, 40 large vegan capsules in each. One jar of Northern Soul sea moss gel. One copy of the book, which the listing says comes with the Konscious Konsumption nutrition guide.
£179.99. One size, listed with no variants.

Not totalled here. Northern Soul is sold in two sizes at two prices and this listing does not say which jar goes in the box, so any total would be a guess at the size. The other two items are £39.99 a jar and £28.00 for the book, as their own pages print.

Not printed for the box. Detox Redox prints no dose, no daily count and no course length on its own listing. Northern Soul prints one tablespoon each morning on its page. The listing says the book holds the step by step instructions.
The listing counts the box in days and prints nothing else about length. Three jars of 40 capsules is 120 capsules, and without a printed serving nobody can turn that into a number of days.
Gel: refrigerate, use within 28 days of opening or freeze, clean dry spoon. Capsules: lid on, cool and dry, no fridge. Detox Redox prints no storage instruction of its own.
Vegans. Adults. Both jars of capsules are vegan and the gel is algae and water.
No milligram figure per Detox Redox capsule. No full ingredient list for it. No jar size for the gel. No schedule for the box. Four gaps, and this page fills none of them.

Anyone with an overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism), because of the seaweed. Anyone who is pregnant or breastfeeding. Children. If you take thyroid medication, a blood thinner, anything for diabetes, or any other prescribed medicine, speak to your GP or pharmacist before you start.
spec.smallprint: Contains iodine from seaweed. Do not exceed the stated dose. Speak to your GP or pharmacist before starting any supplement, particularly if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or take medication. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of reach of young children.

doctrine.h3: We publish the specification. We do not publish claims about what it does.
doctrine.p: Everything on the sheet above is a count, a price or a printed instruction. Where the listing prints nothing, the row says so rather than filling the gap in. 28 Day Kit is the name on the box. It is a name, not a description, and we do not expand it. What any of the three items does in a body is not something we are permitted to tell you, so it is not on this page.

reiss.label: Reiss's turn
reiss.h2: Why the box cannot print a day rate
paras: Three jars, a gel and a book, and the thing missing from the middle of it is a number. Detox Redox carries no serving on its own listing: no dose, no daily count, no course length. So when somebody at the counter asks me whether three jars is a month of anything, the honest answer is that I cannot work it out from what is printed, and neither can you.

The gel is the part I can be exact about. One tablespoon each morning, in the fridge, used inside 28 days of opening. Which of the two jars goes in this box is not printed either, and the two sizes are not the same price, so there is no sold separately total on the sheet above. I would rather leave that row empty than put a figure in it and hope nobody checks.

The book is where the listing sends you for the instructions, and that is where I would send you as well. If you want the serving before you buy rather than after, ring the counter and I will read you what the current label says.
reiss.pull: Three jars, a gel and a book, and not one printed serving between the jars.
